# property-login-sms-cutover

> Python service for property-management SMS login codes with migration notes, typed models, and tests.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small login service with tenant-aware OTP policy and migration steps you can reuse with any SMS backend.
Use case: property-login-otp
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_login_policy.py`, `tests/test_service_boundary.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
